facts.text: Sri Lanka is an Indian Ocean island south of India.
Sinhala and Tamil are official languages.

culture.text: Buddhist, Hindu, Muslim, and Christian communities contribute to Sri Lanka’s cultural landscape.

food.name: Pol sambol
food.text: Grated coconut is mixed with chili and lime in this flavorful accompaniment.
